scenarios.title: Vendor late with a component
scenarios.situation: A supplier's tracking module is ten days late. The trainee must tell the client.
client_objections: When were you going to tell me?
What is the new date, and what does it cost me?
Why should I trust this date?
good_answer_contains: gives a specific new date and who committed to it
says who pays for the delay
says what changes to avoid a repeat
